name: Jon Lajoie
biography: Jonathan 'Jon' Lajoie (born August 21, 1980) is a French-Canadian comedian, actor, rapper, singer, musician and Internet celebrity from Montreal, Quebec. He gained fame mostly from his YouTube channel, "jonlajoie," posting comedic original songs (as rapper E=MC Vagina) and comedy skits. He is also known for his role as Taco MacArthur on the FX comedy series The League.
